title: Zetta-Joule technology
description: A pale-blue section with a featherlight heading left and a paragraph plus button on the right, then a huge 4px-radius photo that drifts inside its frame as you scroll, with a black note box over its lower-left corner (under the photo, full width, on phones).
notes: the photo is full-bleed on phones (390×488) and 1360×890 on desktop
the note box forces the dark colour scope (black)
CSS only; the drift and reveals are off under reduced motion
